title: private-deploy-field-notes-noah-ramirez
content:
Daily scratchpad: private deployment field notes (VPC / on-prem)

Context:
- Customer: Acme Financial (regulated payments).
- Deployment type: VPC + on-prem connector (air-gapped DB via VPN).
- Target go-live window: 2026-03-15 to 2026-03-17 (batch rollout).
- Primary contacts: Sarah Li (infra lead), Mark O'Neill (security).

Prechecks (completed / pending):
- [x] Confirmed on-prem firewall rules and allowed egress CIDR for Redwood control plane.
- [x] Customer provided NAT IP ranges (10.140.0.0/20) and proxy config.
- [ ] Customer KMS integration: waiting on key ARN from security team. Follow-up: Sarah, ASAP.
- [x] AMI/OS image validated (Ubuntu 22.04, kernel 5.15).
- [ ] Storage validation: mount options for XFS vs ext4 (XFS preferred). Customer uses LVM on top of SAN - schedule deep test.
- [x] Inventory of GPUs: 4x A100 40GB per cluster node (confirmed).

High-level install steps (notes / quick commands):
1) Prep network and DNS:
   - Ensure private route for control-plane egress to 52.14.23.0/24 (Redwood-managed) and 18.200.0.0/16 for metrics ingestion.
   - Add DNS entries in customer zone: redwood-ops.acme.internal -> loadbalancer IP.
   - Note: customer uses split-horizon DNS; need to test resolution from build node.

2) Provision nodes / OS hardening:
   - Use terraform module: redwood-private/node-pool (branch: acme-2026).
   - Post-provision: run hardening script: ./ops/harden.sh --profile=pci.
   - Commands: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get dist-upgrade -y; disable unused services (snapd).

3) Container runtime & drivers:
   - Install NVIDIA driver 535 and containerd 1.6.18.
   - Verify: nvidia-smi (should show 4 GPUs) and containerd running.

4) Redwood agent install (private runtime):
   - Pull private bundle from s3 via presigned URL (one-time).
   - Run installer: sudo ./redwood-install.sh --env acme --mode private --kms-arn <TODO> --control-plane 52.14.23.10
   - Expectation: services: redwood-agent, redwood-kvcache, redwood-proxy.

5) Networking for inference:
   - Open ports: 8080 (intra-node gRPC), 9090 (metrics), 8443 (ingress). Confirm firewall rules 10.140.0.0/20 -> internal LB.
   - Ensure MTU consistent with VPN (do not exceed 1500).

6) Model artifacts & storage:
   - Pre-stage models to /mnt/models with checksum verification (sha256).
   - For large model (30B), ensure quantization profile (q4) prepared; test loading via redwood-run --model model-30b-q4.

7) Smoke tests:
   - Run: curl -k https://redwood-local:8443/healthz -> expected OK.
   - Run small generation test (prompt bundle): ./test/prompts/basic-gen.json (10 requests) -> target p50 < 200ms for cached prefix.

Blockers & open issues:
- KMS ARN missing from customer (blocks key provisioning/encryption-at-rest). Owner: Sarah Li.
- Customer's VPN drops packets intermittently when large file transfers occur (likely MTU or flow-control). Suggested workaround: stagger model pre-stage, use rsync with --bwlimit.
- SELinux enabled on some nodes causing container runtime failures on mount (have a mitigation script; customer needs to allow redwood service in policy).
- Monitoring/log shipping require sidecar config change for their Splunk endpoint (token expired). Slack note posted to #private-deploys.

Quick reminders / to-do (personal):
- [ ] Get KMS ARN and confirm key policy by 2026-03-02.
- [ ] Run full load test (2k concurrent tokens) in staging next Wed.
- [ ] Validate rollback plan: verify snapshotting of /mnt/models and restore time < 15 min.
- [ ] Schedule call with Mark (security) for firewall final sign-off (30m).

Runbook snippets / backout plan:
- If install fails after model staging: scale down agent pool, remove /mnt/models, restore snapshot (s3://acme-model-backups/prev).
- If control-plane connectivity lost: manually set agent to offline via local flag and switch traffic to hosted fallback (redwood-fallback-hosted) - inform CS to toggle.

Notes for next onsite engineer:
- Bring: USB with installer bundle, offline copies of model checksums, laptop with VPN and customer jump-host creds.
- Double-check that load balancer health check path is /healthz and returns 200 within 2s.

Meeting notes from 2026-02-24 sync:
- Agreed: Canary rollout 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 72h.
- Action: Customer to provide KMS and Splunk token; Redwood to provide pre-stage checklist and runbook.

Misc quick fragments (tossed here so I don't lose them):
- Possible CIDR clash with internal infra (10.140.0.0/20) and their monitoring cluster (10.140.8.0/21) - need clear map.
- Consider using local proxy for S3 presigned pulls to avoid VPN throughput limits.
- Metric to watch in rollout: token CPU per-req and KV cache hit ratio.

End of scratchpad.

-- Noah
